title: Playlist Providers
description: Register remote M3U playlists with a refresh interval so live TV channels stay up to date automatically.

alert.title: Automatic refresh with TTL
alert.description: Each provider is re-fetched when its TTL expires. The backend preserves ClearKey DRM, headers, proxies, and DNS-over-HTTPS values announced in the playlist entries.

form.enableAutoRefreshHint: Disable to keep the playlist but stop scheduled refreshes.

validation.ttlMinimum: TTL must be at least 1 minute

deleteConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete provider {{name}}? This action cannot be undone.
